documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
Intimation About Receipt Of Approval For Enhancement In Manufacturing Capacity Of Ethanol Plant
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong financial performance for the financial year 2025-26, driven by growth in revenue, operating profit, and net profit. The company achieved operational synergy despite industry and geopolitical headwinds, and successfully operated its newly commissioned grain-based ethanol plant. Management noted volatile global conditions, crude price fluctuations, and currency movements as key risks impacting margins and exports. Going forward, the company anticipates sustained demand growth across its acrylic fibre, CPP film, and ethanol segments. Pasupati Acrylon Limited reported revenue from operations of Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 3.5% to 4.00% CAGR till 2035.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rapid growth of the apparel & textile industry and increasing usage of acrylic fibres for making apparel, the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 3.5% - 4.00% CAGR till 2035.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 5% CAGR till 2033.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 5% CAGR till 2033.

demand_outlook.claim: The global ethanol market is anticipated to register a CAGR of 6.8% from 2023 to 2032.
demand_outlook.quote: The global ethanol market is anticipated to register a CAGR of 6.8% from 2023 to 2032.

demand_outlook.claim: The company anticipates sustained demand growth across segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Your Company anticipates sustained demand growth across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for ethanol is expected to be 1016 Crore litres according to the Expert Committee report of Niti Aayog.
demand_outlook.quote: As per report of Expert Committee of Nity Aayog on Roadmap for Ethanol Blending, the demand for ethanol is expected to be 1016 Crore litres.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for packaged foods is noted to be at an all-time high due to a growing world population and consumer preference for packaged meals.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for packaged foods is at an all-time high due to growing world population.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based ethanol plant and commenced commercial production in March 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The company filed an application to enhance capacity from 150 KL per day to 180 KL per day and received consents from respective authorities.
capex_expansion.quote: Subsequently, the Company had filed an application with the concerned departments to enhance the capacity from 150 KL per day to 180 KL per day due to improve operational efficiency and the Company has received the consents from the respective departments/ authorities in this regard.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the ethanol plant was assessed at Rs. 167 Crore, but the company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far.
capex_expansion.quote: The total project cost was assessed Rs. 167 Crore (excluding working capital margin) but the project was overrun due to Civil work. Company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far which includes Rs. 104 Crore of Term Loan and Balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The company initiated steps to establish a grain-based ethanol project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the ethanol project is stated to be Rs. 167.58 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total Project cost is Rs. 167.58 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore so far on the ethanol project.
capex_expansion.quote: However, the Company has already spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore so far which includes Rs. 44.08 Crores of Term Loan and balance amount out of internal accruals.

margins_costs.claim: Various cost optimisations through alternate sourcing, standardization, process improvements, and operational efficiency led to significant savings.
margins_costs.quote: Various cost optimisation driven by way of alternate sourcing, standardization, process improvements and operational efficiency improvements has led significant savings.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations increased by 8.03% to Rs. 62,143.18 Lakh in FY 2024-25 from Rs. 57,522.82 Lakh in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from Operations stood at Rs. 62,143.18 Lakh as against Rs. 57,522.82 Lakh in the previous financial year, representing an increase of 8.03% over the corresponding period of last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA was Rs. 5,620.09 Lakh in FY 2024-25 compared to Rs. 2,684.93 Lakh in the previous financial year.
margins_costs.quote: EBIDTA was Rs. 5,620.09 Lakh as against Rs. 2,684.93 Lakh in the previous financial year, representing an increase of 109.31% over the corresponding period of last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew by 168.24% to Rs. 3,538.12 Lakh for FY 2024-25.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after Tax was Rs. 3,538.12 Lakh as against Rs. 1,318.99 Lakh in the previous financial year, representing a growth of 168.24% over the corresponding period of last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue and net profit declined during the year due to lower demand and negative returns in the CPP segment caused by persistent falling selling prices.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue and Net profit during the year declined due to lower demand of acrylic fibre and negative return on CPP Segment caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

margins_costs.claim: Since raw material is crude-derived, fluctuations in crude impact raw material prices.
margins_costs.quote: Since raw material is crude derived as such movement either side shall affect the raw material price.

orders_capacity.claim: The production capacity to produce acrylic products of the company is 42,000 MT PA.
orders_capacity.quote: The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 42,000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's production capacity to produce CPP film is 10000 MT PA.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company’s production capacity to produce CPP film is 10000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the company recorded acrylic fibre production of 35,212 MT and sales of 37,878 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,212 MT and sale of 37,878 MT, as against production of 35,198 MT and sale of 33,850 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, production and sale of CPP film was 7,545 MT and 7,621 MT respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 7,545 MT and 7,621 MT respectively as against production and sale of 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively during the previous year with an increase of 18.95% and 18.91% in production and sales respectively over the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, production and sale of ethanol was 41,923 KL and 41,162 KL respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of Ethanol was 41,923 KL and 41,162 KL respectively as against production and sale of 790 KL and 440 KL respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company employed on an average 540 persons during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company employed on an average 540 persons during the year.

orders_capacity.claim: During FY 2024-25, acrylic fibre production was 35,198 MT and sales were 33,850 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,198 MT and Sale of 33,850 MT, as against production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT respectively during the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2025-26.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors decided not to transfer any amount to the general reserve for the year ended 31st March, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, has decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the year ended 31st March, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company spent Rs. 86.00 Lakh towards CSR activities during the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: In view of the above, the Company has spent Rs. 86.00 Lakh towards the CSR activities during the financial year 2024-25 and hence, the Company’s CSR obligation for FY 2024-25 has been duly met in compliance with Section 135(5) of the Companies Act, 2013.

capital_allocation.claim: The board decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24 as internal accruals are being utilized to set up the ethanol plant.
capital_allocation.quote: As the Company’s internal accruals is being utilized to set-up Ethanol Plant, the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: Indian Bank sanctioned a term loan of Rs. 108 Crores for the ethanol project.
capital_allocation.quote: Indian Bank had sanctioned Term Loan of Rs. 108 Crores and as per stipulations of sanction letter, the remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 would be met out of the Company’s internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global acrylic fibre consumption is impacted due to volatility in prices of raw material, energy, coal, and other key inputs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Global Acrylic Fibre consumption is impacted due to volatility in prices of raw material, energy, coal and other key inputs.

risks_headwinds.claim: The fluctuation in crude affects raw material prices, and crude prices remained volatile due to conflicts including the US/Israel-Iran war and Russia-Ukraine war.
risks_headwinds.quote: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in US/Israel-Iran War & Russia-Ukraine War.

risks_headwinds.claim: Since the company is dependent upon imports, fluctuation in foreign exchange i.e. USD vs. INR has a bearing on margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, since the Company is dependent upon imports, the fluctuation in foreign exchange i.e. USD vs. INR has also a bearing on the margin of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Prices of ethanol products are determined by Oil Marketing Companies and the company has no control on the prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The prices of ethanol products are determined by Oil Marketing Companies (“OMC”) and the Company has no control on the prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global crude prices remained volatile due to the conflict in Israel-Hamas War and Russia-Ukraine War.
risks_headwinds.quote: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in Israel-Hamas War & Russia-Ukraine War.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions, trade sanctions, intense competition, and currency risks are cited as key challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geo-political tensions including supply chain disruption, subdued global economic conditions, changes in government policies and trade sanctions and restrictions, intense competition from local and global players, regulatory changes and cyber security threats are key risks which expose the Company to potential challenges and uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in crude oil prices due to ongoing conflicts may affect margins since raw materials are imported.
risks_headwinds.quote: Furthermore, persistent volatility in input costs and foreign exchange risks remains on the radar. These factors can pose risks to the company’s plans, operations, supply chains, cash flows and market access potentially dampening its export business.

management_commitments.claim: The company is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.
management_commitments.quote: The Company has exported to Algeria, Kenya, Peru, Ukraine, Morocco, Tunisia, Ethiopia, Nepal etc. and is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.

management_commitments.claim: M/s. Mehak Gupta & Associates was appointed as Secretarial Auditor for a period of five consecutive years effective from 1st April, 2025 to 31st March, 2030.
management_commitments.quote: appointment of M/s. Mehak Gupta & Associates, Practicing Company Secretary (Sole Proprietorship Firm Registration No. S2015DE321900) as Secretarial Auditor of the Company to conduct the Secretarial Audit of the Company for a period of five consecutive years effective from the financial year 1st April, 2025 to 31st March, 2030

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Sudhir Agarwal was appointed as a Non-Executive Independent Director for a first term of 5 consecutive years from 1st September, 2025 till 31st August, 2030.
management_commitments.quote: be and is hereby appointed as a Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company, not liable to retire by rotation, to hold office for the first term of 5 (Five) consecutive years commencing from 1st September, 2025 till 31st August, 2030.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commence commercial production of ethanol by September 2024.
management_commitments.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
